name: Typed Plan and Execute State Machine
mechanism: Separates planning from execution and records typed task states, dependencies, results and replanning decisions in an explicit state machine.
use_when: Tasks have multiple dependent steps and inspectable milestones
Recovery or audit requires explicit intermediate state
avoid_when: A single bounded action loop is sufficient
The environment changes too quickly for a reusable plan
failure_modes: Plan becomes stale after environment changes
Planner invents dependencies or impossible steps
Executor follows a flawed plan without verification
